meow.speaker: Mochi
meow.text: Mew? (An orange kitten with a white-tipped tail blinks up at you.)

choices.text: Lina misses you. Let's get you home.

purr.speaker: Mochi
purr.text: Purrrr... (Mochi leans into your hand. She seems a little less scared.)

follow.speaker: Mochi
follow.text: (Mochi perks up at Lina's name and scampers off toward the village.)
